articles.summary: HONG KONG, Dec. 23, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — J-Long Group Limited (“JL” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: JL), JL conducts its primary operations of apparel trims solution services in Hong Kong, today announced its unaudited financial results for the six months ended September 30, 2025. Overview: Delivers Strong First Half 2025 Results: Revenue growth by 19.3% and Adjusted EBITDA growth by 40.3% […]
articles.title: J-Long Group Limited Announces First Half 2025 Unaudited Financial Results
